scope: Original 4d809c subtraction and 4d80a6 addition execute their actual software 4d80d5 and hardware 4d80b7 arithmetic. EAX/EDX/EBX/ECX, lazy helper cache writes, preserved ESI/EDI/EBP and stack cleanup compare exactly. Software overflow 4dae94/4e7280 callees are explicit boundaries with matching input registers and arbitrary returned register mutations; their callee internals are outside this proof. Software underflow tail 4e236e executes unchanged. Hardware proves masked x87 rounding with precision 24/53/64 and all four rounding controls, including signed zero, subnormals, NaNs and infinities. Early-zero paths execute before cache initialization. Unmasked x87 exceptions, FPSW/environment, pending x87 exceptions and arbitrary custom helper pointers remain unsupported and unverified; native rejects unsupported execution without changing supplied state.
